message: Last week, we had a surprise power outage that turned into an unexpected family adventure. Instead of panicking, I gathered up our flashlights and lanterns, and we made a cozy little camp in the living room. We charged our phones with a power bank and played board games by the soft glow of our lanterns, sharing stories and laughter. It reminded me that sometimes, turning off the lights can bring out the brightest moments. Have you ever turned a blackout into a fun family night?
